name: terminal
description: AI-native interactive terminal (TUI) for Bun/Node: chat-and-execute terminal with session memory, provider/model routing, tool profiles, output compaction and a no-cloud guard wired into prepack. Ships the `terminal` CLI (package.json also exposes `t` as an alias bin, not declareable under the kit 0.11.1 bin allowlist); there is no MCP server, no HTTP server, and no importable package surface (exports is null). Session history is stored in a local SQLite database at ~/.hasna/terminal/sessions.db (HASNA_TERMINAL_DB_PATH / TERMINAL_DB_PATH override), with config at ~/.hasna/terminal/config.json and user profiles under ~/.hasna/terminal/profiles/. The data backend is the only runtime switch.

waivedStorageEngines.reason: PostgreSQL is not implemented: no code path reads a DATABASE_URL or selects a PostgreSQL store; session history uses the SQLite store at ~/.hasna/terminal/sessions.db only.
